retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered retro layout featuring high-contrast halftone portraits in primary colors paired with a mix of classic serif and thin-stroke script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A black-background cassette cover featuring a top section with bold white serif text, a middle section with stylized script and geometric lettering, and a bottom section containing three overlapping halftone portraits in blue, red, and natural tones.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic hierarchy against a dark field
Overlapping portrait cards creating a sense of depth
Color-coded tracklist text matching the portrait palette
Horizontal rule lines separating title and content sections
coreInvariants: High-contrast halftone texture on all photographic elements
Solid black background for the main canvas
Primary color palette (Red, Blue, Yellow) used for accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typographic titles occupy the top 40%; three overlapping portrait cards occupy the bottom right 60%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The natural-toned portrait card on the far right acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down from the bold white title, through the yellow script, to the tracklist on the left and portraits on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant black negative space on the left side behind the tracklist and at the very top.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for primary display text and portrait borders.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red, Blue, and Yellow for secondary text and halftone tints.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation accents against a zero-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of high-contrast transitional serifs and monolinear scripts.
letterConstructionRules: Display titles use sharp, triangular serifs and high stroke contrast.
Secondary script is monolinear with open loops and a slight rightward slant.
Geometric caps feature extended horizontal bars.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the geometric display font features a long, flat descender hook.
The 'W' in the geometric display font is constructed from two overlapping 'V' shapes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for authority paired with a casual script for personality.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif display style.
Captures the monolinear, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background. On the right side, place three overlapping rectangular cards with white borders. Each card contains a high-contrast halftone portrait of a man singing: the back card is cyan, the middle card is magenta, and the front card is natural grayscale.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white serif text at the top. Below it, add yellow script text. On the left side, add a vertical list of text in alternating yellow, red, and blue colors using a thin script font.

verificationChecks: Check for halftone texture in portraits
Ensure text colors match the portrait tints
Verify the presence of white borders on the cards

postGenerationChecks: Is the halftone effect clearly visible?
recipe.reuseFormula: Black background + Halftone Tri-color Portraits + High-Contrast Serif Title + Monoline Script Accents
